gl:definition.gl:content: lens-scoped attestation consisting of an attester signature over the subject, the subject state commitment, the lens identity and version, the mode (live or snapshot), a verdict with coverage report, and log-anchored time

gl:notes.gl:content: Stamps accrete append-only and are valid under the stamper's lens regardless of the issuer's.
Jurisdiction stamps on a foreign-issued passport correspond to visas; entry and exit stamps correspond to verifier custody events.
Stamps may carry quantity context, inherited by downstream transformations.
